notes.title: Balls Royale 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]BALLS ROYALE 2.0[/h1]

[h3]2.0 is finally here!

Balls are rolling again!
...better than ever![/h3]

[previewyoutube=AWiMw_sIdJQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Stores links:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233780/Balls_Royale/][b]Steam[/b][/url]
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MeatyOreGames.BallsRoyale][b]Google Play[/b][/url]
[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/balls-royale-mobile/id6447994397][b]App Store[/b][/url]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/ZhD5fsh]Join our [b]Discord[/b][/url]
All social links available on: http://www.meatyoregames.com/


List of changes:
[list]
[*] iOS version release
[*] Beautified menus and gameplay scene
[*] Added Multiplayer Groups (Parties) to be able to join the same game with friends
[*] Added Speed-Zone in the middle to speed up the balls when they are rolling through the middle
[*] Addons can now be unlocked by points collected during games
[*] Power-Ups are now collectible. After getting Power-Up you activate it when it's right time for you
    You can hold only one Power-Up. Getting new one will replace previous one
    Only one global Power-Up can be active at a time
[*] SlowMo Power-Up deleted
[*] New Power-Up - Energy Shield
[*] Few new Addons
[*] If you're the one that activated Switcharoo Power-Up, you will see arrows to see which direction the balls will go
[*] Final 1v1 modified
[*] Added eliminations list GUI during gameplay
[*] Added mini-game in menu while waiting for a game
[*] Entire ranking has been reset
[*] Players with more than 25 online games played before version 2.0, will receive special Medal Sticker addon
[*] TOP100 players now have colored nicknames in lobby ranking and lobby chat
[*] Optimization stuff so game runs smoother on older devices
[/list]
...and A LOT more little additions and changes

notes.title: Update 1.3 + Score system explanation
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.3 is here![/h1]
[list]
[*]Game name changed to Balls Royale
[*]Discord link added to social icons
[*]Narrow-Boards Power-Up bug fixed - board is able to reach the ends now
[*]Earthquake Power-Up toned down a bit
[*]Disabled Flashbang while spectating
[*]Simple chat spam protection added
[*]"Match Started" sound effect is now muted when all sounds are muted
[*]Added screen refresh rates options
[*]3 new Achievements (Power-Ups x500, Eliminations x500, Wins x250)
[*]More little tweaks and small features
[/list]
New servers coming soon!

[h1]Score system explanation[/h1]
Player's overall score is decreased by 5% with every game started (10% previously).

In-game scores:
+ 1 for every Defence
+ 5 for Elimination
+ 5 for getting Power-Up (+20 if it's "25 Points Power-Up")
+ Place score -> 50 for 1st, 49 for 2nd, [...], 40 for 10th, [...], 1 point for last place
+ Additional 25 score for winning a match
